description: This file defines the ScriptBlock class which handles rendering and resource management for script blocks within the OrchardCore Liquid templating system, including inline scripts, head scripts, and foot scripts, with support for various attributes and dependencies.

classes.name: ScriptBlock
classes.description: Handles rendering of script resources and inline scripts within the OrchardCore Liquid templating system, supporting attributes like 'name', 'useCdn', 'condition', 'culture', 'debug', 'depends_on', 'version', and location ('at').

methods.name: WriteToAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously processes arguments and statements to render script resources or inline scripts, managing dependencies, locations, and attributes, and writing output to the provided TextWriter.
